    SpaceX reports revenue of $7.8 billion for the second quarter, topping Wall Street estimates. But Elon Musk's company reported an operating loss of $1.26 billion from its AI business. Ross Gerber of Gerber Kawasaki Wealth and Investment Management says SpaceX is still a compelling stock to own. He speaks on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
    AMD Shares Slide After AI Growth Outlook Underwhelms Investors
    Advanced Micro Devices Inc. tumbled in late trading after giving an underwhelming sales outlook, a sign shareholders expected more of a return from the global expansion of AI data centers.
    Data Centers Exposed US Carriers to China Hack, House Panel Says
    US telecommunications companies connected their systems to data centers and related infrastructure in a way that exposed them to cybersecurity vulnerabilities, potentially opening the door to the massive Salt Typhoon hacking campaign that breached several mobile carriers two years ago, according to a House committee.

    The best microwaves in the UK for every kitchen and budget – tested
    They’re perfect for time-poor cooks, but which deserves your counter space? From combi models to smart designs, here’s what our expert recommends • The best air fryers If you’re at a restaurant and hear a ping a couple of minutes before your meal arrives at your table, it’s unlikely to be a good sign. But microwave ovens are a brilliant tool in the home kitchen. They’re fearsomely fast at heating up – or even cooking – food when you’re time-poor and lacking the energy to make something wholesome after a hard day at work. And in hot weather, cooking by microwave isn’t just quick: it also won’t warm your home. Microwaves work best for heating food with a high water content (they make the water molecules in food vibrate to create heat). However, before testing, I asked around to find out what people use theirs for most, with a view to using this information to shape my tests. So much of what is distinctive about Trump’s governance during his second term can serve the consolidation of an autocratic regime and at the same time create particular vulnerabilities for the regime.
